models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_guests
models.description:
Guest identity records used to correlate anonymous access attempts without credentials.

This table represents the system’s guest actor identity. It is used as the parent for guest sessions ({@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_guest_sessions}) so that protected endpoints can be gated by a valid session even before a user authenticates.

The guest actor itself is treated as an identity row; session connection metadata and expiry live in the dedicated guest session table.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used to identify the guest identity for login correlation. This value is unique across all guest identities.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for guest authentication where guest accounts are allowed to authenticate with email/password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null means the guest identity is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_guest_sessions
models.description: Guest session records for permissionless entry gating to protected endpoints. Each row represents a guest authentication/session token instance with connection context (IP and referrer) and an explicit expiration time for security auditing.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address used when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Requested URL or token issuance href associated with this guest session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value recorded at session creation time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this guest session; used to invalidate tokens after expiry.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_members
models.description:
Registered authenticated member accounts for the ERP HRM time tracking service.

This table is the canonical identity record for the "member" actor type and stores credential-based authentication data (email and password hash). It is the parent for member session and member self-service workflow tables such as sessions, password resets, and email verifications (implemented as separate tables in this component).

Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at; business logic should treat soft-deleted members as unavailable for login and membership-related operations.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the login identifier for member authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt/argon hash of the member's password for credential-based authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the member is considered deleted and should not be authenticated.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_member_sessions
models.description:
Member login session records used to authenticate member requests and support security features such as logout/revocation.

Each row represents a single session for exactly one {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id} member, storing connection and request context (IP, href, referrer) along with creation and expiry timestamps for session validity auditing.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (href) associated with the session creation request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header value associated with the session creation request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. After this time the session is considered invalid.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_member_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset requests submitted by a member. Each row represents a single reset token issuance, including the token identifier used by the client and the expiration timestamp for validity checks.

This table references {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id} to associate reset requests with the member who owns the credential reset flow. Rows may be soft-deleted for retention/compliance without breaking referential integrity.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member for this password reset request ({@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id}).

plainFields.name: token_identifier
plainFields.description: Opaque identifier embedded in the reset link/code, used to locate the reset request during verification.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When this password reset token expires and must no longer be accepted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp to hide expired/invalidated reset requests while preserving auditability.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_member_email_verifications
models.description: Stores email verification tokens issued for member accounts so that a member can confirm ownership of their registered email address. Each record belongs to exactly one member and is used to validate a provided token until it expires.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Verification token presented by the member during email confirmation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Verification URL (or route link) associated with this token for client-side confirmation.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the verification was requested.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer for audit context when the verification was requested.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when this token record is invalidated or removed.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When this verification token expires and can no longer be used.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations
models.description:
Stores each organization (tenant) identity and its configuration settings.

An organization is the tenant boundary for all HR and time tracking data. This table holds the core organization profile used for onboarding, context switching, and interpreting business time-related fields such as timezone and fiscal/calendar framing.

It is the root parent of organization-scoped entities like employees, departments, projects, timelogs, and reports in other components via foreign keys.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-friendly organization name shown in the application tenant context.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Brief description of the organization for internal/contextual display purposes.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: Optional logo image URL for branding in the organization context selector.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Currency code used for the organization’s financial framing (e.g., for payroll-related calculations or monetary displays).

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: IANA timezone identifier used to interpret date/time values within this organization (e.g., Asia/Seoul).

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: The month number (1-12) that the organization uses as the start of its fiscal period.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the organization is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_departments
models.description: Stores departments within an organization and supports an optional parent department to model hierarchical org charts. Each department belongs to exactly one organization, and may reference a parent department within the same organization for nesting.

foreignFields.name: parent_department_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent department for hierarchical organization chart nesting within the same organization.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department display name within the organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional free-text description about the department’s purpose or responsibilities.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the department record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the department record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the department record was soft-deleted. Null means the record is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_contracts
models.description:
Employment agreement records for a specific employee within an organization.

This table stores the contractual employment terms such as pay details and working-term attributes. Each contract belongs to exactly one organization and exactly one employee (an employee representation that ties to user identity and organizational context). Contracts support historical tracking through edits managed at the application level; soft deletion is available for retiring records without breaking references.

{@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members} provides the employee context, and {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations} provides tenant isolation.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id}. This contract is issued for a specific employee within an organization.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}. Used for tenant isolation and scoping.

plainFields.name: contract_number
plainFields.description: External/internal contract reference number used for identification and reconciliation.

plainFields.name: contract_title
plainFields.description: Human-readable contract title summarizing the agreement.

plainFields.name: pay_amount
plainFields.description: Pay amount specified by the contract (base amount before unit interpretation).

plainFields.name: pay_currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for the pay amount, typically aligned with the organization currency.

plainFields.name: pay_frequency
plainFields.description: Pay frequency or schedule type defined by the contract (e.g., monthly, biweekly).

plainFields.name: work_term_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date/time of the working term covered by the contract.

plainFields.name: work_term_end_date
plainFields.description: Optional end date/time of the working term. Null indicates an open-ended agreement.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-form notes or clause summaries associated with the contract.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Contract lifecycle status (e.g., active, ended, draft) used to determine whether the terms are currently in effect.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the contract is considered retired without hard deletion.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_contract_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of employment contract data for auditability and historical timeline views.

Each snapshot preserves the contract attributes as they existed at the time of the snapshot. This allows reporting and auditing even after changes are made to the active contract record.

{@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_contracts} is the source entity for the snapshot (many snapshots per contract). The snapshot also stores stable references to the owning {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members} and {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations} to support historical queries.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id} for historical querying.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id} for tenant isolation in historical reads.

plainFields.name: contract_code
plainFields.description: Business code or external reference for the contract at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Contract start date as recorded in the contract at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Optional contract end date as recorded in the contract at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-form notes about the contract captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: hourly_rate
plainFields.description: Pay rate (per hour) captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code used for pay values captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: work_term
plainFields.description: Working term / employment arrangement captured at snapshot time (e.g., full-time, part-time) as defined by the contract.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot record was last updated (typically immutable after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the snapshot record.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_projects
models.description: Projects within an organization. A project represents a workspace/container for tasks and time logging, with a lifecycle status used to filter projects and to prevent starting new timelogs after a project is archived or completed.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Project display name used for selection and filtering within an organization.

plainFields.name: color
plainFields.description: Hex-like or UI color value associated with the project for visual identification in the UI.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the project (e.g., active, archived, completed) used to control allowed time logging and filtering.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the project record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the project record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the project is not deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_project_memberships
models.description:
Links an Employee to a Project as a single, explicit assignment. This table is the basis for determining which employees can manage tasks within a project and for driving the employee’s assigned project list.

Each row represents one employee-to-project membership. The membership includes a role indicator (for example, regular member vs project-lead) that drives authorization decisions at the service layer. Soft deletion is supported so that historical data can be preserved while removing active access.

plainFields.name: membership_role
plainFields.description: Role of the employee within the project (e.g., project-lead vs member). Used to drive permission decisions and UI presentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this project membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this project membership was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the membership is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_tasks
models.description:
Tasks are work items inside a project. Each task belongs to exactly one project, can optionally be nested under a single parent task (one-level nesting), and can optionally be assigned to an employee who is eligible for the project via project membership rules.

This table stores task metadata used for planning and execution such as title, description, workflow status, priority, estimated working hours, due date, and the optional assignee reference. Lifecycle timestamps support auditing and soft deletion.

foreignFields.name: parent_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent task for one-level nesting, referencing {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: assigned_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task assignee referencing the employee {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id}. Eligibility is enforced by membership rules at the service layer.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Human-readable task title.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional additional details describing what the task involves.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task workflow status (e.g., progress state) used to control how the task is handled and displayed.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority level used for ordering and planning.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Optional estimated effort for the task, expressed in hours for planning and reporting context.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for scheduling and reminders. Stored as a datetime.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the task is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_timelogs
models.description:
Recorded time entries for employees within an organization.

Each timelog belongs to an {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id} (member/employee within an organization), is attributed to an {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_projects.id} (project), and may optionally be associated with an {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id} (task within the project). A timelog can also be included in a particular {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_timesheets.id} timesheet week when it has been submitted/approved as part of that timesheet workflow.

This table stores the atomic unit of work captured by the user, including the worked time window/amount and any optional note. Historical changes are preserved in {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_timelog_snapshots} rather than through inline JSON fields.

Soft deletion is supported via {@code deleted_at}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task attribution within the project {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Optional timesheet container this timelog is included in {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_timesheets.id}.

plainFields.name: work_date
plainFields.description: The date/time representing when the work was performed (used for timesheet week grouping).

plainFields.name: start_time
plainFields.description: Optional start timestamp of the work interval.

plainFields.name: end_time
plainFields.description: Optional end timestamp of the work interval.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Total duration of the worked entry in minutes.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional free-form note describing the work performed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the record is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly container that groups an employee’s timelogs for a specific time period and drives the approval workflow.

Each timesheet belongs to exactly one employee within exactly one organization and represents one week (or week-like period) identified by start/end boundaries. Timelogs are associated from the timelog side (via an optional timesheet reference), while this table stores the workflow status used to control editing and approval flows.

plainFields.name: week_start_at
plainFields.description: Start timestamp of the timesheet week period (inclusive).

plainFields.name: week_end_at
plainFields.description: End timestamp of the timesheet week period (inclusive or exclusive based on service interpretation).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Workflow status of the timesheet (e.g., draft, submitted, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was submitted for approval.

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was approved.

plainFields.name: rejected_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this timesheet record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this timesheet record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the record is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_timer_sessions
models.description:
Live tracking session started by an employee while recording time. The session stores the employee's currently selected project and optional task, along with a running description used during active tracking.

This table supports concurrency-safe access by limiting active sessions per employee (only one row marked as active for a given employee). Soft deletion is supported via {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_timer_sessions.deleted_at} for auditability.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Running description text attached to the active tracking session.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: When the tracking session started.

plainFields.name: ended_at
plainFields.description: When the tracking session ended, if it has finished.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this session is currently active for the employee (only one active session per employee).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when the session is removed from active use but retained for history/audit.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_versioning_locks
models.description: Locks a specific timesheet to prevent concurrent edits during versioning and workflow-sensitive periods. The lock is owned by an editing actor context so the system can determine whether an update is allowed and can safely release the lock when editing is completed.

foreignFields.name: timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: The locked timesheet that this versioning lock applies to ({@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_timesheets.id}).

plainFields.name: locked_by_user_id
plainFields.description: The user identifier that holds the lock for the timesheet versioning session (used to enforce lock ownership and safe release).

plainFields.name: lock_reason
plainFields.description: Human-readable reason or workflow context for why the lock was created (e.g., editing, approval preparation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the versioning lock record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the versioning lock record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; set when the lock is released/cancelled and should no longer be treated as active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_timelog_snapshots
models.description: Point-in-time audit history for an employee timelog. Each row captures the full state of a timelog at the moment of snapshot creation, preserving historical values even when the live {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_timelogs} record is edited or its workflow state changes.

plainFields.name: organization_id
plainFields.description: Organization owning this timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: employee_id
plainFields.description: Employee that owns this timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: project_id
plainFields.description: Project associated with the timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: task_id
plainFields.description: Optional task associated with the timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: timesheet_id
plainFields.description: Optional timesheet that includes this timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Start timestamp of the work interval recorded in the timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: ended_at
plainFields.description: End timestamp of the work interval recorded in the timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Computed duration in minutes for the interval recorded in the timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: work_description
plainFields.description: Free-text description/notes of the work for the timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: source_timer_session_id
plainFields.description: Optional timer session that produced this timelog at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: workflow_status
plainFields.description: Workflow status of the timelog at the time of the snapshot (e.g., draft/submitted/approved/rejected).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time of the snapshot record metadata.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time for snapshot retention and administrative recovery.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries
models.description:
Organization-scoped audit activity entries recording who performed an action, when it happened, what action type occurred, and which target entity was affected. This table is used as a cross-domain observability and audit trail that can reference different business entities through a typed target reference without duplicating business data. Ownership is enforced via {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries.organization_id} pointing to {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}. The actor performing the action is stored via {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries.performed_by_member_id}.

Target entity linkage is represented by a typed reference ({@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries.target_entity_type} + {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries.target_entity_id}) so the audit log can cover updates across the whole application without introducing multiple nullable foreign keys.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization for which this audit entry is recorded {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: performed_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member user who performed the action {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Logical action key representing what happened (e.g., created, updated, approved, rejected) in an application-specific taxonomy.

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Business entity type name of the affected target (e.g., timesheet, timelog, project). Used together with target_entity_id for polymorphic targeting.

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: Business entity identifier of the affected target. Combined with target_entity_type to form a typed target reference.

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Human-readable short summary of the activity for auditing and support. Kept generic to avoid duplicating full target entity details.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Optional additional human-readable context explaining the change for auditing purposes (e.g., key parameters, notes).

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: When the action actually occurred in business time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the audit entry record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the audit entry record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for logically removing the audit entry when required by data retention policies.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entry_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time immutable snapshots of {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries} state for audit retention.

Each row captures the full, queryable context of an activity log entry as it existed at the time the snapshot was created, so historical audit trails remain available even if referenced domain entities are later updated or deleted.

This table is append-only in practice and is designed for safe long-term audit queries by time, actor, and affected target entity.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entry_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged activity log entry that this snapshot represents {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_activity_log_entries.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization tenant of this audit snapshot {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_action_type
plainFields.description: Categorization of the action type that occurred for this activity log entry snapshot.

plainFields.name: snapshot_action_summary
plainFields.description: Human-readable summary of what the activity represents for audit viewing.

plainFields.name: performer_type
plainFields.description: Actor category that performed the action (e.g., member). Used with performer_id for polymorphic performer lookup in application queries.

plainFields.name: performer_id
plainFields.description: Actor identifier of the performer for this snapshot. Pair with performer_type for polymorphic lookup.

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of the entity affected by this activity log entry snapshot.

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the affected entity. Pair with target_entity_type for polymorphic lookup.

plainFields.name: target_additional_info
plainFields.description: Optional extra textual details helpful for audit interpretation about the target entity at snapshot time (stored as plain text, not structured JSON).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot record update time (should rarely change after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the snapshot record.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definitions
models.description: Organization-owned persisted report configuration. Each row represents a reusable report definition that can later be used to generate report runs and outputs for the {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id} tenant context.

foreignFields.name: creator_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who created this report definition for organizational audit and traceability {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Stable unique code identifying this report definition within the organization (used by clients and integrations).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable report name displayed in reporting UI.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer explanation of what the report represents and how it is intended to be used.

plainFields.name: report_type
plainFields.description: Report type key (e.g., a template identifier) that determines supported output shape for generated runs.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this report definition is currently active and eligible for new generations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this report definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this report definition was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null means the definition is not deleted.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_generation_runs
models.description: Persisted record for each generation of a time-tracking report based on a specific report definition. Stores generation status for auditability and operational traceability, along with the generation parameter summary needed to reproduce/identify the run.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definition_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged report definition {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definitions.id} that this generation run was created from.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the generation run (e.g., pending, running, succeeded, failed).

plainFields.name: parameters_summary
plainFields.description: Atomic summary string of the generation parameters used for this run to support traceability and debugging.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: When generation started. Nullable because a run may be created in a pending state before starting.

plainFields.name: finished_at
plainFields.description: When generation finished (successfully or with failure).

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Error message captured when the run fails; null for successful runs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp due to status/metadata changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when the record is active.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_outputs
models.description: Generated report output rows/aggregations produced for a specific report generation run. Each row represents one grouped result (e.g., per employee/project/task, optionally per week) and can be further broken down by metric lines via {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_output_metrics}.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Grouped task {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}. If the report definition does not include task grouping, this may be null.

foreignFields.name: week_start_date_id
foreignFields.description: Optional grouped week start date token referenced from report definition grouping settings. When the report definition uses week dimension, this identifies the week bucket; otherwise it is null.

plainFields.name: grouping_sort_key
plainFields.description: Deterministic string key derived from grouping values for stable ordering and deduplication across generators.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive notes stored with this output grouping (e.g., for exports or debugging).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the report output row.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time of the report output row.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time of the report output row.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_output_metrics
models.description:
Optional per-output breakdown lines for multi-metric reports.

Each record stores one metric (identified by metric_name) and its metric_value for a single generated report output row. This normalizes metric name/value pairs so that report outputs can be generated with varying metric sets without storing arrays or JSON in a single field.

This table belongs to a specific {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_outputs} row and is typically read and exported together with its parent output. Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at for audit-safe removal.

plainFields.name: metric_name
plainFields.description: Metric identifier/name for this breakdown line (e.g., 'hours', 'amount', 'billable_hours').

plainFields.name: metric_value
plainFields.description: Numeric value of the metric for the parent report output row.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the metric line is treated as removed without hard deletion.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definition_dimensions
models.description:
Report grouping dimensions configured for a specific {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definitions.id}.

Each row represents exactly one dimension used when aggregating report output (for example employee, project, task, or week). The record is designed to be managed as part of the report definition configuration, not as a standalone entity.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definition_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged report definition {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definitions.id} that owns this grouping dimension.

plainFields.name: dimension_key
plainFields.description: Machine-readable key identifying the grouping dimension (e.g., "employee", "project", "task", "week").

plainFields.name: dimension_label
plainFields.description: Human-friendly label for the dimension used in report output headers or UI rendering.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: 1-based ordering of dimensions for deterministic grouping and presentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the dimension is considered removed from the configuration.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definition_filters
models.description: Defines a single filter rule configured for an {@link erp_hrm_time_tracking_report_definitions.id} report definition. Each row represents one filter condition in a relational form so that report generation can reliably apply filtering without storing JSON arrays.

plainFields.name: field_key
plainFields.description: The logical key of the report field/attribute to which this filter applies (e.g., employee, project, task, date range).

plainFields.name: operator
plainFields.description: The comparison/operator used to evaluate this filter (e.g., equals, not_equals, in_list, contains, between).

plainFields.name: value_text
plainFields.description: The primary filter value serialized as text for atomic storage. The interpretation depends on the selected field_key and operator.

plainFields.name: value_text_2
plainFields.description: Optional second value for range-style operators (e.g., between start/end).

plainFields.name: is_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether this filter is currently enabled for the report definition.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Ordering hint for deterministic evaluation/presentation of multiple filters for the same report definition.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the filter is active.
